scopeNote: For post-secondary study permit applicants, including Quebec’s additional requirements where applicable. School admission, permit approval, post-graduation work and PR are separate decisions. Community averages combine applications within this guide and are not IRCC processing estimates.

relatedPathways.label: Post-graduation work permit
relatedPathways.description: Check your school, program and individual PGWP eligibility before planning to work after graduation. A study permit alone does not guarantee a PGWP.

relatedPathways.label: Canadian Experience Class
relatedPathways.description: Qualifying Canadian work may support CEC eligibility. Work gained while studying full-time does not count toward the CEC minimum. Meeting eligibility does not guarantee an invitation.

relatedPathways.label: Provincial nominee programs
relatedPathways.description: Check the province’s current stream rules, selection process and settlement-intent requirements. A permit alone does not qualify you for nomination or guarantee PR.

steps.title: Choose a school and program
steps.description: Confirm admission at a designated learning institution (DLI). If post-graduation work is part of your plan, check the specific program’s PGWP eligibility before enrolling.

preparationChecklist.text: Check the school and program with the official DLI/PGWP information.
Keep a copy of your admission requirements.

commonMistakes: DLI admission does not mean every program qualifies for a PGWP.

steps.title: Get your acceptance letter
steps.description: Obtain your letter of acceptance and confirm that your school can validate it for IRCC.

requiredDocuments.title: Letter of acceptance
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Check the program, campus and start date.

steps.title: Check PAL/TAL and Quebec requirements
steps.description: Most applicants need a provincial or territorial attestation letter. Check exemptions, including qualifying master’s and doctoral degree programs at public DLIs from January 1, 2026. Quebec study requirements, including a CAQ where required, still apply.

requiredDocuments.title: PAL/TAL or exemption evidence
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

requiredDocuments.title: Quebec Acceptance Certificate (CAQ)
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Request the PAL/TAL through your school, or document your exemption.
For Quebec, follow the CAQ instructions linked by IRCC.

commonMistakes: A PAL/TAL is not a provincial nomination for PR.

steps.title: Prepare funding and identity evidence
steps.description: Use the current IRCC financial-support requirements for your application date, family size and province. Prepare identity records and your explanation of the study plan.

requiredDocuments.title: Passport or travel document
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

requiredDocuments.title: Proof of financial support
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

requiredDocuments.title: Study-plan explanation
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Check the linked proof-of-funds page for current amounts.
Plan for tuition, living costs and travel without relying on future Canadian earnings.

steps.title: Submit your study permit application
steps.description: Follow the instructions for your location and submit the forms, documents and fees through the applicable IRCC process.

requiredDocuments.title: Completed application and supporting documents
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Check whether you are eligible to apply from within Canada.
Save the submitted application and payment receipt.

commonMistakes: Being in Canada as a visitor does not automatically make you eligible to apply from inside Canada.

steps.title: Complete requested checks
steps.description: Provide biometrics, a medical exam or police certificates when required. Follow each IRCC request and its deadline.

requiredDocuments.title: Biometrics instruction letter
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

requiredDocuments.title: Medical or police evidence if requested
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

steps.title: Wait for the decision
steps.description: Check your IRCC account and respond to requests. An application submission is not permission to study or work.

preparationChecklist.text: Keep your school informed if your intake date changes.

steps.title: Receive approval and check your permit
steps.description: If approved from outside Canada, follow the arrival instructions: a letter of introduction is not the study permit. Check the permit issued to you and any travel-document requirements.

requiredDocuments.title: Approval letter and issued permit
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Verify your name, school, expiry and conditions.

steps.title: Follow study and work conditions
steps.description: Remain enrolled and actively pursue your studies. Eligible off-campus work is limited to 24 hours weekly during regular terms; different rules apply during scheduled breaks. Check authorization before any work.

preparationChecklist.text: Review rules before changing schools or taking leave.
Check the separate rules for a co-op or internship.

commonMistakes: Do not start working before your study program begins.

steps.title: Plan what comes after study
steps.description: Review PGWP eligibility before graduation and track the application deadline. Explore PR routes only against their separate requirements.

preparationChecklist.text: Use the related pathways below when ready.
Keep school and work records for later applications.
